notes: Drive Health accuracy fix. When a drive is connected through a USB enclosure/adapter that blocks its real SMART, Windows hands back placeholder values (0% wear, an all-zero serial) — and the tool used to read those as a genuine 100% healthy. It no longer does: it now detects the bridge placeholder and shows 'Can't read — connect the drive directly for a true reading' instead of a false green ring, on the Drive Health card, the Overview tile and the printed/Syncro report. A heavily-worn SSD in a caddy can no longer hide behind a fake 100%. (Reading real SMART through common USB bridges is coming next.)
